When the module has multiple spacing fields (e.g. Text Box Padding), each applies to its intended target only — see MODULE-SETTINGS-BACKGROUND-STANDARD §1.

children.name: background_image_md
children.label: Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_md
children.label: Tablet Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_md
children.label: Tablet Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_md
children.label: Tablet Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_md
children.label: Tablet Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_sm_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Theme Color is set to Custom.

children.name: background_custom
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Solid color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient colors and direction when Background Option is Gradient.

children.name: content_colors
children.label: Content Colors
children.help_text: Content Area text and link colors. Use when background is image/gradient/custom and theme defaults do not apply correctly. Does not apply to headings—they have their own color settings.

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Theme defaults uses cascade. Choose a theme color or Custom for a hex color when content sits on image/gradient/custom backgrounds.

children.name: text_color_custom
children.label: Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Hex color when Text Color is Custom.

children.name: link_context
children.label: Link Colors
children.help_text: When links are on a dark background, choose Dark. When on light background, choose Light. Required when Text Color is Custom since cascade cannot infer it.

children.name: Column_Width_Setting
children.label: Column Width Settings
children.help_text: Controls the width of the secondary column. Main content fills the remaining space. 12 columns = stacked on all screens.

children.name: secondary_cols_lg
children.label: Desktop Column Width
children.help_text: Controls the secondary column width on desktop. Main content fills the rest. 12 = stacked.

children.name: secondary_cols_md
children.label: Tablet Column Width
children.help_text: Controls the secondary column width on tablet. Select Inherit to use Desktop Column Width.

children.name: Pillar_Image_Setting
children.label: Secondary Column Settings
children.help_text: Layout for the secondary column (applies to image, video, content, and form). Image-specific options are hidden when secondary column is content, video, or form.

children.name: desktop_image_position
children.label: Desktop Column Order
children.help_text: Which column appears on the left (or on top when stacked at 12 cols). Secondary Column on Left/Top = secondary on left/top; Secondary Column on Right/Bottom = main content on left/top.

children.name: tablet_image_position
children.label: Tablet Column Order
children.help_text: Which column appears on the left (or on top when stacked at 12 cols). Select Inherit to use Desktop Column Order.

children.name: mobile_image_position
children.label: Mobile Column Order
children.help_text: Which column appears on top. Secondary Column on Top = secondary on top; Secondary Column on Bottom = main content on top.

children.name: image_as_background
children.label: Image as Background
children.help_text: Display the image as a full-height background in the column. Only applies when secondary column is image.

children.name: override_image_border_radius
children.label: Override Media Border Radius
children.help_text: When enabled, use the custom corner radius below (Image or Video depending on secondary column type). When disabled, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings. Applies to both images and videos.

children.name: image_border_radius
children.label: Image Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the image. Set to 0 for no border radius.

children.name: video_border_radius
children.label: Video Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the video. Set to 0 for no border radius.

children.name: Form_Box_Settings
children.label: Form Box Settings
children.help_text: Styling for the form when Secondary Column is set to Form. Background, border radius, and padding.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Form Box Background Color
children.help_text: Background color behind the form. Set opacity to 0 for transparent.

children.name: border_radius_override
children.label: Override Form Box Border Radius
children.help_text: When enabled, use the Form Box Corner Radius value below. When disabled, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings.

children.name: border_radius
children.label: Form Box Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the form box. Set to 0 for no border radius.

children.name: border_override
children.label: Form Box Border
children.help_text: When enabled, show a border around the form box with the style, width, and color below.

children.name: border_style
children.label: Border Style
children.help_text: Style of the form box border.

children.name: border_width
children.label: Border Width (px)
children.help_text: Width of the form box border in pixels.

children.name: border_color
children.label: Border Color
children.help_text: Color of the form box border.

children.name: shadow_override
children.label: Form Box Shadow
children.help_text: When enabled, apply a soft drop shadow to the form box.

children.name: hide_label
children.label: Hide Field Labels
children.help_text: Hide labels for text/email/textarea fields. Checkbox and radio labels remain visible.

children.name: fields
children.label: Field Styling
children.help_text: Customize form input field appearance. Default uses theme styles.

children.name: button
children.label: Button Styling
children.help_text: Button style, size, alignment, and custom colors.

children.name: padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Top padding around the form content.

children.name: padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Bottom padding around the form content.

children.name: padding_left
children.label: Padding Left (px)
children.help_text: Left padding around the form content.

children.name: padding_right
children.label: Padding Right (px)
children.help_text: Right padding around the form content.

children.name: Content_Area_Setting
children.label: Content Settings
children.help_text: Text alignment for the main content area and secondary content area (when Secondary Column is set to Content).
children.inline_help_text: Main content and secondary content (when Secondary Column is Content).

children.name: text_align_default
children.label: Text Alignment
children.help_text: Default text alignment for all screen sizes. Can be overridden for tablet and mobile.

children.name: override_md_text_align
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_md
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: override_sm_text_align
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_sm
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: list_type
children.label: List Type
children.help_text: Numbered (ol), Bullet (ul with disc), Custom Icon (Font Awesome), or Custom Image.

children.name: default_bullet_image
children.label: Default bullet image
children.help_text: Custom image used as the bullet marker for all list items.

children.name: default_bullet_icon_purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: Decorative adds aria-hidden for screen readers.

children.name: bullet_font_size
children.label: Bullet list font size
children.help_text: Applies to all list items (numbered and bullet).

children.name: list_item_bottom_spacing
children.label: List item bottom spacing
children.help_text: Bottom padding for each list item (spacing between items).

children.name: list_left_padding
children.label: List left padding
children.help_text: Left padding of the list. Set to 0 for flush against the container.

children.name: list_icon_text_gap
children.label: Space between icon and text
children.help_text: Space between the icon, number, or bullet and the list item text. Applies to all items.

children.name: default_bullet_icon_color
children.label: Default bullet icon color
children.help_text: Leave empty to inherit text color.
